headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin unveils its Fenix 9 smartwatches with OLED displays. Features a 3,000-nit screen, twice as bright as its predecessor. Priced from $999.99, it boasts 50% more RAM.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: DHS announces over $103,000 fee for H-1B visas. State Department plans to revoke up to 200,000 asylum seeker visas. These moves impact legal immigration and tech industry hiring.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: Inscryption, from Daniel Mullins (Pony Island 2), is on sale for $8. It's a secret-packed deckbuilder available on Steam via Humble. A great way to discover the acclaimed developer.

headline: The Witcher 3 is getting a remaster
summary: CD Projekt Red is remastering The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. The updated RPG launches September 29th with improved visuals and combat. Includes a reimagined skill tree and first two games.

headline: Showa American Story: The First Hands-On Preview
summary: Showa American Story creates an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world. Its deliberate jank and niche style mean polish lags behind AAA titles. Unique but flawed, offering a fascinating ride.

headline: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank With Dual USB-C Cables Drops to Just $45.29
summary: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank is now $45.29. This deal includes dual USB-C cables. No Amazon Prime membership required for this discount.

headline: The Dog Stars Review
summary: Ridley Scott's post-apocalyptic drama "The Dog Stars" reviewed. The film explores grief but keeps emotions guarded. A cautious approach to its heavy themes.

headline: Konami Partners With Celebrity Kitty to Release Metal Gear Cat Toys at CatCon 2026
summary: Konami teams up with 'one-eared Uno' for a new venture. They are releasing a special Metal Gear cat toy collection. The toys will debut at CatCon 2026.

headline: Dolly Parton: The life of an iconic country singer
summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has passed away at 80. Her team announced the news on social media. Celebrating the life of a legendary artist.

headline: Father's house rammed before son died in A66 crash
summary: The house of Cole Worthy's father was severely damaged. Windows were smashed in a ramming incident. This occurred before his son died in an A66 crash.

headline: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
summary: US media reports CIA chief is in Moscow for unannounced talks. Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia. The trip was via Latvia on Tuesday.

headline: Winter energy prices expected to rise to three-year high
summary: Winter energy prices are projected to reach a three-year high. Millions of households will be affected by the increase. Regulator Ofgem is raising the energy price cap.
